prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: a photorealistic tabletop travel-merch concept arrangement, using ONE consistent whale-girl artwork identity.
Input images: Image1 is the exact chibi master for ALL surface artwork. Image2 reinforces standard colors and costume details; do not switch identities.
Three objects only, naturally arranged on an ordinary pale wooden bench against a neutral softly lit background. One unbleached cotton-canvas shoulder tote with dark-navy handles, visible weave, real stitched seams and a full-body chibi whale-maid screen print centered on its front. One simple cream glazed ceramic mug beside it, handle clearly attached and usable, printed with the same chibi character and a tiny blue whale motif. One small die-cut clear acrylic chibi keychain with an attached real silver split ring and short navy woven loop, placed in front with a visible transparent edge. Depict these as proposed tangible designs, not real manufactured goods.
The character's blue OPEN eyes and navy-to-blue hair must remain recognizable and undistorted on all three surfaces, with the single tail visible in the full-body prints. Printing follows canvas folds and mug curvature, not stickers floating above surfaces. Keep the face and apron in the same soft natural shade as the material around them. Preserve modest cream/blue colors, use marks and ordinary daylight; no dramatic glare or unreal bright face patches.
Whole objects visible, balanced horizontal medium product photo, enough separation to see each design. No humans, food, plants, unrelated decor, package, captions or lettering.
Constraints: Every depiction is the SAME DeepSeek fan whale-maid as the supplied project masters: navy-to-light-sea-blue flowing long hair, a single curved ahoge, smooth side head fins, wide OPEN blue eyes, white frilled maid headband with side blue ribbon, navy/white feminine maid dress and lace-edged white apron with a little blue whale pictogram, fine muted gold hem accents, and one broad blue whale tail. No glasses. No closed eyes or alternate identity. All faces are printed, illustrated or embroidered fictional character art only. No real people, hands, body parts, extra characters, speech, packaging claims, price tags, text, watermark, brand wordmarks or decorative slogans.
